notes.note: Hewett has been up and down with his scoring this season and isn't showing what we saw in previous years. However he was one of just two Blues over 100 this week. Hold if you have him.
This is now two scores in the 70s from Hewett which is a concern for owners. He had just the 18 disposals.
Hewett was the best scorer for the Blues as he is looking in for another good season.
